ledger_accounts_code_kind_chk.name: ledger_accounts_code_kind_chk
ledger_accounts_code_kind_chk.value: ("ledger_accounts"."kind" = 'system' and "ledger_accounts"."code" is not null) or ("ledger_accounts"."kind" = 'wallet' and "ledger_accounts"."code" is null)

pay_users_tag_chk.name: pay_users_tag_chk
pay_users_tag_chk.value: "pay_users"."tag" is null or ("pay_users"."tag" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(_[a-z0-9]+)*$' and length("pay_users"."tag") between 3 and 20)
